title: ALLEXCEPT as a table expression returns the distinct combinations of the columns not listed

source.quote: ALLEXCEPT materializes all the unique combinations of the columns in the table specified in the first argument that are not listed in the following arguments
source.supports: as a table function ALLEXCEPT returns the unique combinations of the table's columns that are not listed

derivation: Product has columns ProductKey, Product, Color, Category, Price. All but Color are listed, so the result is the unique values of Color: Red (twice in the table, once in the result), Blue, Green.
